# YouTube

*Product*

Google's video platform; its videos appear in Search, and channels can be added to Search Console as platform properties.

18 claims mention it: 1 from Google's documentation, 15 shown or said at the event (4 not in Google docs, 4 confirmed by Google docs, 5 consistent with Google docs, 2 nothing to verify), 2 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

- [`D1-C125`](../sessions/D1-S02-what-s-new-in-the-world-of-search.md) Docs: Since 16 September 2026, US publishers and creators qualify for a Search profile with 10,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram, X or TikTok, and media organisations can claim and manage profiles for all their sub-brands from one login. `[D1-C125, docs, Google blog (16 September 2026), https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/3-new-ways-were-improving-search-profiles-for-publishers/]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D2-C547`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: Gary Illyes said over 219 million people in Southeast Asia consume content on or through YouTube daily (the daily scope was heard in two independent recordings but is not verified). `[D2-C547, stage, Gary Illyes, Day 2]`
- [`D3-C444`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, not in Google docs: Google said it is working on adding more platforms to Search Console's platform properties beyond Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube. `[D3-C444, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C452`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, not in Google docs: In the example YouTube report shown in Google's Search Console talk, long-form videos still got more traffic and more impressions from Google than Shorts; this was one example channel, not a general finding. `[D3-C452, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C590`](../sessions/D3-S16-mastering-the-messy-middle.md) Slide, Day 3, not in Google docs: Google's slide advised partnering with category opinion formers, such as YouTube creators, experts and institutions, who can give consumers extra reassurance. `[D3-C590, slide, Google, Day 3]`
- [`D2-C748`](../sessions/D2-S24-google-trends.md) Stage, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: Google Trends data covers searches on Google Search, including web, image, shopping and news search, plus searches on YouTube. `[D2-C748, stage, Omri Weisman, Day 2]`
- [`D3-C443`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Platform properties let a user verify ownership of an Instagram, TikTok, X or YouTube account in Search Console and see the traffic Google sends to that account. `[D3-C443, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C450`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: Because platform properties bring many new users to Search Console, Google published documentation and strategy guidance on them, covering how to identify the Search audience, use the 24-hour real-time view, export data and compare platforms such as Instagram and YouTube. `[D3-C450, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D3-C451`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, confirmed by Google docs: In a YouTube platform property, long-form and short-form videos can be compared in the Performance report's comparison mode by URL pattern, /watch versus /shorts/; Instagram posts (/p/) and reels can be compared the same way. `[D3-C451, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D1-C497`](../sessions/D1-S01-welcome-and-opening-keynotes.md) Stage, Day 1, consistent with Google docs: Google said YouTube has surpassed Netflix as the number one streaming service, in the US and around the world. `[D1-C497, stage, Lino Cattaruzzi, Day 1]`
- [`D2-C928`](../sessions/D2-S13-using-images-to-your-advantage-and-engaging-search-users-with-videos.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: Gary Illyes suggested considering video hosting platforms such as YouTube or Vimeo, because they solved video search years ago. `[D2-C928, stage, Gary Illyes, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C749`](../sessions/D2-S24-google-trends.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: Google Discover is not included in Google Trends, because Discover is a content feed with no search box, while Trends counts only the queries people type into Google Search or YouTube. `[D2-C749, stage, Omri Weisman, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C819`](../sessions/D2-S24-google-trends.md) Stage, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: Google has published a YouTube series of about eight episodes on using Google Trends for research, journalism, marketing and SEO. `[D2-C819, stage, Omri Weisman, Day 2]`
- [`D3-C448`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Stage, Day 3, consistent with Google docs: The platform property landing page lists the account's top-performing content items, for example a channel's top YouTube videos, and the items trending up and trending down. `[D3-C448, stage, Ariel Kroszynski, Day 3]`
- [`D1-C148`](../sessions/D1-S01-welcome-and-opening-keynotes.md) Stage, Day 1, nothing to verify: The keynote's third driver was that information quality remains a core focus for Google, which wants high-quality sources to serve across Google Search, its AI experiences in Search, YouTube and Discover. `[D1-C148, stage, Lino Cattaruzzi, Day 1]`
- [`D2-C959`](../sessions/D2-S14-lightning-session-f-media.md) Stage, Day 2, nothing to verify: From one unified interview transcript, a community speaker's workflow produces a full article for the website and shorter angles for LinkedIn, Substack, X and YouTube. `[D2-C959, stage, Patrick Domanico, Day 2]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D1-C498`](../sessions/D1-S01-welcome-and-opening-keynotes.md) Analysis: Cite YouTube's lead as US streaming watch time measured by Nielsen: that is the figure YouTube publishes, and no published Google source backs the keynote's 'around the world'. `[D1-C498, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D3-C453`](../sessions/D3-S12-inside-search-console-what-s-new-how-to-use-it.md) Analysis: Media teams that publish on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or X should add each account as a Search Console platform property and compare formats by URL pattern; Google's July 2026 post says an account already used for a Search profile should already give access to its data. `[D3-C453, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
